# Lembaran
> Personal Digital Archive Vault — v3.5.0

## About
Lembaran is a local-first note management application with end-to-end encryption (AES-GCM + Argon2id). No third-party servers — data is stored entirely on the user's device.

## Monorepo Structure
```
packages/
  core/   — Shared logic: encryption, storage adapter, AI, Sentinel
  cli/    — Terminal interface (TUI) built with Bun & Ink
  web/    — Next.js 16 app (App Router + Turbopack)
```

## Web Architecture (packages/web)
- **Framework**: Next.js 16.1.6, React 19, Turbopack
- **URL Routing**: `app/[locale]/` → all pages prefixed with `/id/` or `/en/`
- **i18n**: `next-intl` — URL-based locale, not state
  - `i18n/routing.ts` — locale config (`id` default, `en`)
  - `i18n/request.ts` — server config, loads messages JSON
  - `i18n/navigation.ts` — locale-aware `Link`, `useRouter`, `usePathname`
  - `middleware.ts` — auto-redirect to locale prefix
  - `messages/id.json`, `messages/en.json` — UI translation dictionaries
- **State management**: Zustand via `@lembaran/core/Store`
- **Storage**: IndexedDB (browser) via `BrowserAdapter`, JSON file (Node) via `FileAdapter`

## Core Architecture (packages/core)
- `Archive.ts` — High-level CRUD operations for notes
- `Vault.ts` — Cryptography engine (AES-GCM, Argon2id)
- `Storage.ts` — Storage abstraction (auto-detect browser vs Node)
- `Sentinel.ts` — Background tasks & autonomous agent (**NOT** exported from index.ts — import directly: `@lembaran/core/Sentinel`)
- `Linguist.ts` — AI translation (Gemini)
- `Store.ts` — Zustand global store
- `Context.ts` — Context/path resolver (Node-only, dynamic import)
- `storage/BrowserAdapter.ts` — IndexedDB adapter
- `storage/FileAdapter.ts` — JSON file adapter (Node.js)

## Important Rules for AI

### Importing Sentinel
```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT (CLI only)
import { Sentinel } from '@lembaran/core/Sentinel';

// ❌ WRONG — causes node:child_process to enter browser bundle
import { Sentinel } from '@lembaran/core';
```

### Use i18n navigation (not next/link directly)
```typescript
// ✅ CORRECT — locale-aware
import { Link, useRouter, usePathname } from '@/i18n/navigation';

// ❌ Avoid in [locale] pages — not locale-aware
import Link from 'next/link';
```

### Locale in client components
```typescript
// Get current locale
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
const locale = useLocale(); // 'id' | 'en'
const t = useTranslations('NamespaceName');
```

### Environment Variables
- `.env` is in the **monorepo root** — Next.js reads it via `dotenv` in `next.config.ts`
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — for AI translation (Linguist/SecretScrubber)
- `DB_PATH` — custom path for FileAdapter (CLI)

## Dev Commands
```bash
bun run dev      # Start dev server on port 1400 (auto-kill port first via predev)
bun run build    # Sync assets + next build
bun run lint     # ESLint all packages (web + core + cli)
```

## Naming Conventions
All code uses **English** identifiers:
- `Archive` = Notes manager
- `Vault` = Crypto engine
- `Storage` = Storage layer
- `Store` = Zustand state
- `Context` = Context resolver
- `Sentinel` = Background task manager
- `Linguist` = AI translator
- `Poet` = AI provider manager

## Pages (app/[locale]/)
| URL | Page |
|-----|------|
| `/id/` or `/en/` | Landing page |
| `/id/pustaka` | Notes list (main app) |
| `/id/catatan/[id]` | Note editor |
| `/id/bantuan/[slug]` | Documentation (markdown) |
| `/id/laras` | Settings |
| `/id/jatidiri` | Profile |
| `/id/cari` | Search |
| `/id/versi` | Changelog |
| `/id/tentang` | About |
| `/id/privasi`, `/id/ketentuan` | Legal |
